items.title: August 1, 1996: The U.S. men's Olympic basketball team advances to the gold medal game with a 101-73 win over Australia in Atlanta.
items.author: NBA Cobwebs
items.body_excerpt:
August 1, 1996: The U.S. men's Olympic basketball team advances to the gold medal game with a 101-73 win over Australia in Atlanta.

Charles Barkley had 24 PTS (7-7 FG)/11 REB and David Robinson scored 14 PTS for Team USA. Australia's Andrew Gaze scored 25 PTS and Shane Heal added 19 PTS (4-8 3P).
